description:
- Updated to HushGram 0.0.22 for Instagram 456.0.0.53.78.
- Added an optional search scope for the current settings section and all nested pages; settings home continues to search everything.
- Applied Material colors to the Instagram-style settings layout and refined the restart indicator on toggles.
- Improved accent backgrounds for inbox and Activity rows, chat input surfaces, and pinned-message strips, with added contrast for the pinned strip.
- Updated held-message blur for Compose chats while preserving the selected message area.
- Aligned reactions with held-message bounds and removed the extra message-menu edge gap.
- Preserved independent Settings and Compose controls in the inbox header and native inbox hold-menu behavior.
- Integrated parent updates and placed new settings in related sections.
- Expanded focused native-hook and UI regression checks.
- Includes the MPP bundle, dependency SBOM, build identity, and SHA-256 checksums.
- Install using stock Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and refresh the InstaPrime source in Morphe Manager.
- Core patches and upstream maintenance: [SysAdminDoc and HushGram contributors](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram). [Support the original creator](https://ko-fi.com/X8K126YVER).
